## Project report
`GET /projects/:id/report` returns `{ "project_id", "counts": { "todo", "doing", "done" }, "overdue": [...] }`.
`overdue` lists the open tasks whose due date has passed, most overdue first, each with `id`, `title`,
`due_date` and `days_overdue`. `days_overdue` counts working days since the due date: weekends and
public holidays are not counted.
